data.body: RP17 final disposition: PERMANENTLY REJECTED on 2026-09-01 and excluded from Janitor Cleanup ticketization. Added known-fine entry KF-S18-gerrit-ebs-ambient-encryption-defaults for exactly resource.aws_ebs_volume.data and resource.aws_instance.gerrit.root_block_device in infra/terraform/main.tf. Normalized SHA-256: c4fa5474ad90a98e37155736465185b44623aa930e1233fd3e4af66fcd4ec92b. The location was not a temporal hotspot at confirmation. Fingerprint change, pattern spread, or new hotspot membership makes the entry stale and returns S18 to normal verification. Draft rationale for one-line maintainer confirmation: Maintainer permanently rejected repository-enforced Gerrit EBS encryption and accepts this exact reliance on ambient AWS EBS encryption defaults.
